mapper.update: UPDATE w16_contact_counter SET contacts=contacts+1 WHERE actor_id=#{actor}

mapper.select: SELECT role_clue FROM w16_role_secret WHERE ticket_id=#{ticketId}

mapper.select: SELECT 1 FROM w16_safety_report WHERE reporter_id=#{reporter} AND reported_id=#{reported}
